source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

title: How I knew I was ready to be a mom (I wasn't)

lines.en: I only now realized the shift, the identity whiplash.
lines.zh: 我直到現在才意識到那種轉變，那種身分上的劇烈衝擊。

lines.en: All of that actually happened as soon as I moved back to LA from New York.
lines.zh: 其實這一切在我從紐約搬回洛杉磯的時候就已經發生了。

lines.en: That was already the time where I was thinking, if I'm not my work, then who am I?
lines.zh: 那時我就已經在想：如果我不是我的工作，那我是誰？

lines.en: If I'm not productivity queen, if I'm not waking up at 4:30 a.m., if I'm not setting all these new systems and color coding my notion, then who am I?
lines.zh: 如果我不是「生產力女王」，如果我不再凌晨四點半起床，不再建立各種新系統、在 Notion 上用顏色分類，那我是誰？

lines.en: Hello friends. It's time. It's time for us to talk about motherhood.
lines.zh: 哈囉朋友們。時候到了，是時候來聊聊當媽媽這件事了。

lines.en: Now that I've lived it for a year and a half, I've had time to process it.
lines.zh: 我已經當了一年半的媽媽，有時間好好消化了。

lines.en: I've had time to live it.
lines.zh: 我有時間真正去經歷它。

lines.en: I can finally talk about it.
lines.zh: 我終於可以來談談了。

lines.en: This is the first video in a five-part series.
lines.zh: 這是五集系列的第一集。

lines.en: I don't think the videos are going to come back to back.
lines.zh: 我想這幾支影片不會一支接一支馬上推出。

lines.en: But these are all the things that you can expect to kick us off. these questions that you guys posed in the last video is the best place to start.
lines.zh: 不過這些就是你們可以期待的內容。先從你們在上一支影片提出的問題開始，是最好的起點。

lines.en: So, Chloe asked, "I'm curious how the transition from independent working women with successful career to devoting yourself to motherhood was for you."
lines.zh: Chloe 問：「我很好奇，從事業有成、獨立工作的女性，轉變成全心投入當媽媽，這個過程對你來說是怎樣的？」

lines.en: Fiona asks, "Brutal reflection on the identity shift from girl boss to mom life, especially for your subscribers who are on the fence about mom life.
lines.zh: Fiona 問：「請毫不保留地反思從女強人到媽媽生活的身分轉變，特別是給還在猶豫要不要當媽媽的訂閱者。

lines.en: Is it just chaos?" Oh, is it just chaos?
lines.zh: 是不是一團混亂？」喔，是不是一團混亂？

lines.en: It's more than chaos, but it's beautiful.
lines.zh: 不只是混亂，但它很美。

lines.en: It's very, very beautiful. and we're going to get into all of that to start.
lines.zh: 真的非常非常美。我們一開始就來聊聊這些。

lines.en: Yes, the transition from to this.
lines.zh: 是的，從那樣到這樣的轉變。

lines.en: It's it's a it's quite a big transition.
lines.zh: 這、這是一個相當大的轉變。

lines.en: While I was thinking about this in the shower yesterday, I realized the transition in it of itself wasn't too shocking or drastic for me.
lines.zh: 昨天我在洗澡時想著這件事，發現這個轉變本身對我來說並沒有太震撼或太劇烈。

lines.en: I feel like I've known since I was young that I wanted to eventually be a mom.
lines.zh: 我覺得我從小就知道自己終究會想當媽媽。

lines.en: And I was very well aware of the mom that I wanted to be because I had a very present mother.
lines.zh: 我也很清楚自己想當什麼樣的媽媽，因為我的母親一直都很陪在我身邊。

lines.en: Wonderful, caring, incredible, inspirational, driven, so driven.
lines.zh: 她很棒、很體貼、很了不起、很激勵人心、很有衝勁，非常有衝勁。

lines.en: She's I'm not going to I'm not going to say her age out loud because she watches all of my videos.
lines.zh: 她……我不要、我不要說出她的年紀，因為她每一支影片都會看。

lines.en: She's going to be like, "Why did you tell them how old I am?"
lines.zh: 她一定會說：「你幹嘛告訴大家我幾歲？」

lines.en: She is aging very gracefully.
lines.zh: 她老得非常優雅。

lines.en: Yet this woman has more energy than me.
lines.zh: 但這位女士的精力比我還旺盛。

lines.en: She's doing so many things.
lines.zh: 她做好多事情。

lines.en: She's juggling so many things.
lines.zh: 她同時兼顧好多事情。

lines.en: I don't feel like she's ever going to slow down.
lines.zh: 我覺得她永遠不會慢下來。

lines.en: Me saying all of this is she devoted herself to my brother and I when we were younger.
lines.zh: 我說這些是想說，在我和我哥哥小時候，她全心全意投入在我們身上。

lines.en: And I think that was my example of what it means to be a mother.
lines.zh: 我想那就是我心中「當媽媽」的榜樣。

lines.en: And of course, when you're young growing up, you're like, I'm never going to be like my mom. I don't like her.
lines.zh: 當然，小時候你會想：我才不要像我媽一樣。我不喜歡她。

lines.en: Uh sometimes I'd even be like, I hate her.
lines.zh: 呃，有時候我甚至會說：我討厭她。

lines.en: But the older I've gotten, the more I realized it was just me being a teenager, me, you know, going through the developmental things that all children go through in their teenage years.
lines.zh: 但年紀越大，我越明白那只是我在青春期，經歷所有孩子在青少年時期都會經歷的成長過程。

lines.en: And now looking back, it's like, wow, she was a great mother.
lines.zh: 現在回頭看，會覺得：哇，她真是個很棒的媽媽。

lines.en: She was always home for us.
lines.zh: 她總是在家陪我們。

lines.en: She was always there for us.
lines.zh: 她總是在我們身邊。

lines.en: And in my mind, that was always the picture of if and when I become a mother, that's what I'd like to do and how I'd like to mother.
lines.zh: 在我心中，那一直是「如果有一天我當了媽媽」的樣子：我想那樣做，想那樣當媽媽。

lines.en: So, because I had that vision in mind of the mother that I want to be, I felt like I was very well aware of what it means to be a mother and how all-consuming it can be.
lines.zh: 因為心裡有了自己想成為的母親樣貌，我覺得我很清楚當媽媽代表什麼，以及它會多麼占據你的一切。

lines.en: I'm all or nothing. So, if I'm going to be the a mother, I'm just I'm going to be a mother to the best of my ability.
lines.zh: 我是全有或全無的人。所以如果我要當媽媽，我就會盡我所能當個好媽媽。

lines.en: And I was also very well aware that it may come with some sacrifices.
lines.zh: 我也很清楚這可能會伴隨一些犧牲。

lines.en: I don't like thinking of it as sacrifices because I don't want it to ever feel like I'm sacrificing myself for my kids.
lines.zh: 我不喜歡把它想成犧牲，因為我不希望自己覺得是在為孩子犧牲自己。

lines.en: But it does change your life a lot in many, many, many ways.
lines.zh: 但它確實在很多很多方面大大改變你的生活。

lines.en: So, all that being said, this is why I lived the way I lived and worked the way I worked when I was in my 20s and my early 30s.
lines.zh: 說了這麼多，這就是為什麼我在二十幾歲和三十出頭時，會那樣生活、那樣工作。

lines.en: Because I remember, if you watch some of my oldest older videos, you may remember this was around 2012, 2013.
lines.zh: 因為我記得，如果你看過我一些最早期的影片，可能會記得，大概是 2012、2013 年左右，

lines.en: I went back to Taiwan with my parents because my grandparents weren't doing the best.
lines.zh: 我和爸媽回台灣，因為我的祖父母身體狀況不太好。

lines.en: They were going through some health issues.
lines.zh: 他們有一些健康問題。

lines.en: And while being back being with my parents, taking care of my grandparents, going to appointments, just seeing what their life entailed at their age,
lines.zh: 回去和爸媽在一起、照顧祖父母、陪他們看診，看到他們在那個年紀的生活是什麼樣子，

lines.en: it made me realize these next 10ish years of my life are the only time I'm going to have fully to myself.
lines.zh: 讓我意識到，接下來大約十年，是我人生中唯一能完全屬於自己的時間。

lines.en: And I think I was in my like late teens, very late teens.
lines.zh: 我那時大概是十幾歲快二十歲，非常接近二十歲。

lines.en: I was 19, 20 around this time.
lines.zh: 那時我大概 19、20 歲。

lines.en: I could see my life play out.
lines.zh: 我可以看見我的人生會怎麼走。

lines.en: If I were to get married around, let's just say 28, that was like the golden number in my head.
lines.zh: 如果我在，就說 28 歲結婚吧，那是我心中的黃金數字。

lines.en: If I got married at 28, had kids around 30, by that time, my time is no longer my time because I have a husband and I have kids.
lines.zh: 如果 28 歲結婚、30 歲左右生小孩，到那時我的時間就不再是我的了，因為我有老公、有小孩。

lines.en: And as my kids grow, when I'm in my 40s or 50s, that's also going to be when my kids are a little older, maybe they're off to college.
lines.zh: 等孩子長大，我四、五十歲的時候，孩子也大一點了，也許去上大學了。

lines.en: But it's also around the same time that my parents will start going through health problems.
lines.zh: 但差不多同一時間，我的父母也會開始出現健康問題。

lines.en: And so I would of course as a daughter want to take care of them and be there for them.
lines.zh: 身為女兒，我當然會想照顧他們、陪在他們身邊。

lines.en: So the next decade of my life is truly the only time that I have for my soul.
lines.zh: 所以接下來這十年，真的是我唯一能留給自己的時間。

lines.en: So if that is the case, if that is the constraint, if that is what we're working with, what can I do?
lines.zh: 那麼如果情況是這樣，如果這就是限制，如果這就是我們手上的條件，我能做什麼？

lines.en: How can I live in a way so that I set myself up for success?
lines.zh: 我要怎麼生活，才能為自己打好成功的基礎？

lines.en: And success isn't like success, you know, in that way.
lines.zh: 這裡說的成功不是一般人想的那種成功。

lines.en: How can I live in a way so that I can look back when I'm 80 and be like, great, you did the right thing.
lines.zh: 我要怎麼生活，才能在 80 歲回頭看時說：很好，你做了對的事。

lines.en: You you did everything you could to live as true to you as possible.
lines.zh: 你、你盡了一切努力，盡可能忠於自己地活著。

lines.en: And that really was the gauge because during this time, the question that I was trying to answer was, what does it mean to live a meaningful and fulfilling life?
lines.zh: 那真的就是我的衡量標準，因為那段時間我一直想回答的問題是：怎樣才算活出有意義、充實的人生？

lines.en: So anyway, you guys know the rest of the story.
lines.zh: 總之，後面的故事你們都知道了。

lines.en: That was why it drove me to work the way that I did. the 4:30 a.m. wakeups, the routines, the systems, the, you know, late nights in the office, the working two jobs, the dedicating my life to my work.
lines.zh: 這就是驅使我那樣工作的原因：凌晨四點半起床、各種例行公事、各種系統、在辦公室待到很晚、身兼兩份工作、把人生奉獻給工作。

lines.en: Even though on the outside it looked like my identity, it truly was just I wouldn't say I'm cosplaying because that was the life that I lived,
lines.zh: 雖然從外表看起來那像是我的身分，但其實……我不會說是在角色扮演，因為那確實是我過的生活，

lines.en: but it was more of like an external manifestation of my inner values of if spirituality,
lines.zh: 但它更像是我內在價值觀的外在展現：心靈、

lines.en: family, and then work are the most important things to me because I feel like work can be something that can have a positive impact on the world.
lines.zh: 家庭，然後是工作，是我最重視的東西，因為我覺得工作可以對世界產生正面的影響。

lines.en: Those are the things that are most important to me.
lines.zh: 這些是對我來說最重要的事。

lines.en: How can I live in a way so that my life is aligned with these three values?
lines.zh: 我要怎麼生活，才能讓人生和這三個價值觀一致？

lines.en: And so similarly in this season of my life as a mother in my motherhood era, it's also the same thing just the role has changed.
lines.zh: 同樣地，在我當媽媽的這個人生階段，也是一樣的道理，只是角色改變了。

lines.en: It's still an expression of my values, but family just gets bumped up in priority because it's the thing in front of you that needs immediate attention.
lines.zh: 它依然是我價值觀的展現，只是家庭的優先順序被往前挪了，因為它就在你眼前，需要你立刻處理。

lines.en: I was going to say it's on fire.
lines.zh: 我本來想說它像是著火了一樣。

lines.en: Can be sometimes, but not all the time.
lines.zh: 有時候是，但不是隨時都是。

lines.en: So, while the outer role flipped completely, like the the label of girl boss, I don't even like that label, but just it's the easiest way to explain this.
lines.zh: 所以雖然外在角色完全翻轉，像是「女強人」這個標籤，我其實不喜歡這個標籤，只是這樣最好解釋。

lines.en: Girl boss and mother can not be more different.
lines.zh: 女強人和媽媽再怎麼看都是天差地別。

lines.en: They're both just byproducts of what was inside, like the values that are inside. is also why we literally spent a decade on YouTube talking about the importance of knowing your values,
lines.zh: 但它們都只是內在的產物，也就是內在的價值觀。這也是為什麼我們在 YouTube 上花了整整十年談「了解自己價值觀」的重要性，

lines.en: knowing who you are, and being able to stay true to that.
lines.zh: 了解自己是誰，並且能忠於自己。

lines.en: So, I guess you could say that I've been preparing to be a mother for the past decade plus.
lines.zh: 所以我想可以說，過去十多年來我一直在為當媽媽做準備。

lines.en: Being a mother wasn't like a goal. It wasn't a goalpost.
lines.zh: 當媽媽不是一個目標，不是一個終點線。

lines.en: It was just a thing within my grand scheme of life design that I knew I wanted.
lines.zh: 它只是我整體人生設計中，我知道自己想要的一件事。

lines.en: It was never this thing where I was like, I need to be a mother and this is going to be my identity.
lines.zh: 我從來不是那種「我一定要當媽媽，這會是我的身分」的想法。

lines.en: This is going to be my life.
lines.zh: 「這會是我的人生。」

lines.en: It's more of I know that in this current season, this role will be the dominant role that I'm playing because my child is young and because my child needs me.
lines.zh: 比較像是：我知道在目前這個階段，這會是我扮演的主要角色，因為我的孩子還小、我的孩子需要我。

lines.en: But as I continue to grow, I will assume different roles, different identities, wearing different hats.
lines.zh: 但隨著我繼續成長，我會承擔不同的角色、不同的身分，戴上不同的帽子。

lines.en: So, I just wanted to clarify that there's nothing wrong if motherhood is your end goal, but I also feel like it could complicate it because if we start living for our kids, then that's pressure to our kids.
lines.zh: 所以我想說清楚，如果當媽媽是你的終極目標，那沒有什麼不對，但我也覺得它可能讓事情變複雜，因為如果我們開始為孩子而活，那對孩子是一種壓力。

lines.en: And this is a separate video that I'm not going to get into right now. Yes.
lines.zh: 這是另一支影片的主題，我現在先不談。是的。

lines.en: And as you guys know, I am a homebody.
lines.zh: 還有你們都知道，我是個宅女。

lines.en: So, me being home is a gift.
lines.zh: 所以能待在家對我來說是一份禮物。

lines.en: It is the greatest gift is to be home with my son, to be home with my family. It is a blessing.
lines.zh: 能和兒子、和家人一起待在家，是最棒的禮物，是一種福氣。

lines.en: I am so grateful and I love it.
lines.zh: 我非常感恩，也很喜歡。

lines.en: I know it's not for everyone.
lines.zh: 我知道這不適合每個人。

lines.en: I know for people like Jams, they need to physically recharge by going out and going to coffee shops and experiencing the buzz and the hum of life.
lines.zh: 我知道像 Jams 這樣的人，需要出門、去咖啡店、感受生活的熱鬧氣息，才能充電。

lines.en: But for me, I'm very content with being home.
lines.zh: 但對我來說，我很滿足於待在家。

lines.en: So, I think that also made it a bit more palatable.
lines.zh: 所以我想這也讓一切比較容易接受。

lines.en: While my life did change a lot, and while my circumstances have changed a lot, and while everything's changed a lot,
lines.zh: 雖然我的生活改變了很多，雖然我的處境改變了很多，雖然一切都變了很多，

lines.en: and while the whiplash of girl boss to motherhood is so real, I felt like I was prepared enough for it, it wasn't all-consuming in the way that it could have been.
lines.zh: 雖然從女強人到媽媽的衝擊非常真實，但我覺得自己準備得夠充分，它並沒有像可能的那樣吞沒我的一切。

lines.en: However, I only now realize the whiplash, the the shift, the identity whiplash, the shift, all of that actually happened as soon as I moved back to LA from New York.
lines.zh: 不過我直到現在才意識到那種衝擊、那個轉變、身分上的衝擊，其實在我從紐約搬回洛杉磯時就已經發生了。

lines.en: That was already the time where I was thinking, if I'm not my work, then who am I?
lines.zh: 那時我就已經在想：如果我不是我的工作，那我是誰？

lines.en: If I'm not productivity queen, if I'm not waking up at 4:30 a.m., if I'm not setting all these new systems and color coding my notion, then who am I?
lines.zh: 如果我不是「生產力女王」，如果我不再凌晨四點半起床，不再建立各種新系統、在 Notion 上用顏色分類，那我是誰？

lines.en: And because I couldn't come up with an answer and then I got pregnant and then I had a kid, I never really came up with an answer.
lines.zh: 因為我想不出答案，接著就懷孕、生了小孩，所以我始終沒有真正找到答案。

lines.en: So, I still don't really have an answer.
lines.zh: 所以我到現在其實還是沒有答案。

lines.en: But I think that in it of itself is the beauty of it because sometimes we don't need an answer and we don't need to put a label on everything.
lines.zh: 但我覺得這件事本身就是它美好的地方，因為有時候我們不需要答案，也不需要替每件事貼上標籤。

lines.en: For as much as we want to know, there's also beauty in just allowing yourself to be.
lines.zh: 就算我們很想知道，只是允許自己好好存在，也有它的美。

lines.en: So, by the time I gave birth and started mothering, I've already been thinking about some of these really big identity pieces that we will all eventually face years before.
lines.zh: 所以等我生產、開始當媽媽時，我早在幾年前就已經在思考這些我們終究都會面對的、很重大的身分課題。

lines.en: The coolest thing about becoming a mother is actually being able to see yourself put everything you've learned, everything that you've worked on,
lines.zh: 當媽媽最酷的地方，其實是能看到自己把學過的一切、努力過的一切，

lines.en: every mindset habit that you developed, every like real life habit that you developed for yourself to help yourself navigate this very challenging, beautiful, new, chaotic,
lines.zh: 每一個培養出來的心態習慣、每一個為自己建立的生活習慣，都拿來幫助自己度過這段非常有挑戰、美好、全新、混亂、

lines.en: testing, trying, but like so wonderful and like you feel like you're in a cocoon,
lines.zh: 考驗人、磨人，但又非常美妙的時期，你會覺得自己像在一個繭裡，

lines.en: but then sometimes the cocoon bursts open and you have no idea what's going on and you try to gather the pieces and then it slips through your hands, but then you're able to get it again and then you just look at your kids' face.
lines.zh: 但有時候繭突然破開，你完全不知道發生什麼事，你試著把碎片撿起來，它又從指縫溜走，但你又能再抓回來，然後你看著孩子的臉，

lines.en: You're like, "All is well in the world."
lines.zh: 你會想：「世界一切都很好。」

lines.en: And then they're not sleeping at night, so you're like, "What is what is my life and what is going on?"
lines.zh: 然後他們晚上不睡覺，你又會想：「我的人生到底是怎樣、到底發生什麼事？」

lines.en: Anyway, there's a lot happening.
lines.zh: 總之，發生的事情很多。

lines.en: But because you are faced with challenges you've never faced in your life before, like keeping a newborn alive, it really, really,
lines.zh: 但因為你面對的是人生中從沒遇過的挑戰，像是讓一個新生兒活下去，它真的、真的、

lines.en: really tests you and allows you to apply everything you've learned to muster every ounce of courage and to deep into the deepest, deepest corners of your mind to pull out the things that you know can make you feel like yourself.
lines.zh: 真的很考驗你，也讓你把學過的一切拿來運用，鼓起每一分勇氣，深入內心最深處，把那些能讓你覺得「這才是我」的東西挖出來。

lines.en: For example, mindset habits. One thing that has helped me the most is remembering that everything is temporary.
lines.zh: 舉例來說，心態習慣。對我幫助最大的一件事，是記得一切都是暫時的。

lines.en: The fact that my baby is this young is temporary. Newborn phases temporary. Baby not sleeping temporary. Nursing temporary.
lines.zh: 寶寶這麼小是暫時的。新生兒階段是暫時的。寶寶不睡覺是暫時的。餵母奶是暫時的。

lines.en: This crazy phase of life also temporary.
lines.zh: 這段瘋狂的人生階段也是暫時的。

lines.en: And the reason why I'm able to really like embrace the temporariness of it all is because I experienced loss and grief at you know an earlier age.
lines.zh: 我之所以能真正接受這一切都是暫時的，是因為我比較早就經歷過失去和悲傷。

lines.en: And to lose someone really helps put these things into perspective.
lines.zh: 失去一個人，真的能幫你把這些事情看得更清楚。

lines.en: And the second thing that comes from this is it makes me realize how precious life is and how special it is and how magical it is that we are alive because not everyone gets to be even if they want to.
lines.zh: 從這裡來的第二件事，是讓我明白生命有多珍貴、多特別，我們能活著有多神奇，因為不是每個人都能如願活下去。

lines.en: No matter how hard we all try, we all can't live forever, right?
lines.zh: 不管我們多努力，我們都無法永遠活著，對吧？

lines.en: And so the fact that everything's temporary, life is so special, and the last thing that I didn't even realize I was doing until my mom told me,
lines.zh: 所以一切都是暫時的、生命很特別，還有最後一件事，我甚至沒意識到自己在這樣做，直到我媽跟我說，

lines.en: she was like, you know, ever since you're young, when you really, really pour yourself into something, when you find something that you love, you give it 100%.
lines.zh: 她說：你知道嗎，你從小就是這樣，當你真的全心投入一件事、找到你喜歡的東西，你就會百分之百付出。

lines.en: So it also makes sense that with motherhood, you're giving it 100%. I wrote something down.
lines.zh: 所以當媽媽也是一樣，你百分之百地付出。我有寫下來一句話。

lines.en: I think yes on working hard being present giving it your all always.
lines.zh: 我認為要認真努力、活在當下、永遠全力以赴。

lines.en: So that in the future you won't look back and be like oh I wish I did something differently or I could have done something differently or I could have should have would have.
lines.zh: 這樣將來回頭看時，你就不會說：喔，我真希望當初做得不一樣、我本來可以那樣做、早知道應該那樣。

lines.en: You can look back and be like I wish things had gone differently but you would never doubt yourself or have regrets of not trying.
lines.zh: 你可以回頭說：我希望事情有不同的結果，但你永遠不會懷疑自己，或後悔自己沒有嘗試。

lines.en: So, I think those are like the three things that really helped.
lines.zh: 所以我想這三件事真的很有幫助。

lines.en: And this is answering Fiona's question of systems.
lines.zh: 這也是在回答 Fiona 關於「系統」的問題。

lines.en: Did it go out the window?
lines.zh: 這些都被丟到九霄雲外了嗎？

lines.en: Doesn't go out the window.
lines.zh: 並沒有。

lines.en: I feel like what you learned, if you learned it, is literally engraved in your soul. And if anything,
lines.zh: 我覺得你學過的東西，只要真的學會了，就是刻在你靈魂裡的。甚至可以說，

lines.en: the coolest thing that I learned that I'm going to keep talking about throughout this whole series is that did you know the human brain is the most plastic during infancy and early childhood and then it's adolescence and then it is when you become a parent.
lines.zh: 我學到最酷、整個系列會一直提到的一件事是：你知道嗎，人的大腦在嬰兒期和幼兒期可塑性最高，接著是青春期，然後就是你成為父母的時候。

lines.en: Isn't that so cool? That is wild. So wild.
lines.zh: 是不是超酷？太瘋狂了，真的太瘋狂了。

lines.en: While your child's brain is growing, developing, changing, molding into who they're going to be, yours can also be doing the same thing.
lines.zh: 在孩子的大腦成長、發展、改變、塑造成他們將來的樣子時，你的大腦也可以做同樣的事。

lines.en: Well, it is doing the same thing.
lines.zh: 嗯，它確實正在做同樣的事。

lines.en: But it's also what you feed it that is what helps it grow, right?
lines.zh: 但你餵給它什麼，才是幫助它成長的關鍵，對吧？

lines.en: Cuz I think that's that's what we want to do.
lines.zh: 因為我覺得那、那就是我們想做的。

lines.en: We all want to grow and learn and improve ourselves in these ways.
lines.zh: 我們都想用這些方式成長、學習、讓自己變得更好。

lines.en: So, I just thought this was super neat.
lines.zh: 所以我覺得這真的超棒的。

lines.en: Has systems thinking supported you as a new mom? Absolutely. Yes.
lines.zh: 系統思維有幫助你這個新手媽媽嗎？絕對有。有。

lines.en: I feel like it just is like such a solid solid foundation for you to fall back on.
lines.zh: 我覺得它就是一個非常、非常穩固的基礎，讓你有所依靠。

lines.en: It's like the you don't rise to the level of your goals,
lines.zh: 就像那句話：你不會提升到目標的高度，

lines.en: you fall to the level of your systems like truly to have systems in place for yourself to even know that there is systems thinking I think is already really helpful and did it all go out the window while you survived and now you can use some of your tools.
lines.zh: 而是會落到你系統的水準。真的，能為自己建立系統，甚至光是知道有「系統思維」這回事，我覺得就已經很有幫助了。至於在求生存的時候，這些是不是全都拋到腦後、現在能不能再用上一些工具？

lines.en: It didn't all go out the window.
lines.zh: 並沒有全部拋到腦後。

lines.en: I feel like if anything, when you do become a parent, you're more so confronted with, especially if you decide to stay at home with your kids, you're more confronted with the lack of time.
lines.zh: 我覺得真要說的話，當你成為父母，尤其如果你決定在家帶小孩，你更常面對的是時間不夠。

lines.en: Like, with this 5 minutes or with this 20 minutes, what am I going to do?
lines.zh: 像是：有這 5 分鐘或這 20 分鐘，我要做什麼？

lines.en: What can I do in 5 minutes to make me feel like myself?
lines.zh: 5 分鐘內我能做什麼，讓我覺得自己還是自己？

lines.en: Okay, I'm going to wash my face.
lines.zh: 好，我去洗個臉。

lines.en: What can I do in 20 minutes for me to feel like myself?
lines.zh: 20 分鐘內我能做什麼，讓我覺得自己還是自己？

lines.en: I'm going to sneak in a quick workout or I'm going to go outside for a quick walk.
lines.zh: 我偷偷做個快速運動，或出去快走一下。

lines.en: More recently, there was a five hobbies trend going viral.
lines.zh: 最近有個「五個嗜好」的潮流在網路上爆紅。

lines.en: I don't think it's a trend, but this is just this chart of everyone just needs five hobbies to be able to be their best self and live their best life.
lines.zh: 我不覺得它是潮流，它就是一張圖表，說每個人只需要五個嗜好，就能成為最好的自己、過最好的生活。

lines.en: And you really just need a hobby to stay healthy, a hobby to stay creative, a hobby to connect, a hobby to stay peaceful, and a hobby to grow.
lines.zh: 你真的只需要一個保持健康的嗜好、一個保持創意的嗜好、一個與人連結的嗜好、一個保持平靜的嗜好，和一個讓自己成長的嗜好。

lines.en: This is great for non-mothers and it is great for mothers because instead of feeling like you have to do a thousand things,
lines.zh: 這對不是媽媽的人很棒，對媽媽也很棒，因為與其覺得自己得做一千件事，

lines.en: you truly only just need one of each and that's five hobbies and five hobbies seems so much manageable, then the mountain of things that you want to try and you want to do.
lines.zh: 你其實每一類只需要一個，也就是五個嗜好，而五個嗜好比起你想嘗試、想做的一大堆事情，感覺可行多了。

lines.en: So yes, these are the five hobbies for me and the things that I've been leaning on to help me feel like myself and to help me feel good.
lines.zh: 所以對，這就是我的五個嗜好，也是我一直仰賴、幫助我覺得自己還是自己、讓我感覺良好的東西。

lines.en: So, going back to the identity piece.
lines.zh: 那麼，回到身分這個話題。

lines.en: Can I turn on the light?
lines.zh: 我可以開個燈嗎？

lines.en: I feel like it's getting a little dark. Light the motherhood journey.
lines.zh: 我覺得有點暗了。來照亮這段當媽媽的旅程。

lines.en: I'm going to go through all of that in the next video from pre-reg to pregnancy to postpartum to every single thought that I had about me, who I am, who do I want to be, do I want to be a mother?
lines.zh: 下一支影片我會把這些全部講完，從備孕、懷孕到產後，還有我對自己的每一個想法：我是誰、我想成為誰、我想當媽媽嗎？

lines.en: Of course, I already am a mother, but like what kind of mother do I want to be in terms of the time spent?
lines.zh: 當然，我已經是媽媽了，但就花多少時間陪伴來說，我想當什麼樣的媽媽？

lines.en: And I know in the beginning I said that I was prepared for the life change, but obviously the motherhood journey in and it of itself,
lines.zh: 我知道一開始我說我對人生的改變有所準備，但顯然，當媽媽這段旅程本身，

lines.en: it's swirly swirl loopde-loop ongoing still ongoing and it will keep going because there's no end point to being a mother.
lines.zh: 就是轉啊轉、繞來繞去、一直在進行、到現在還在進行，而且會一直持續下去，因為當媽媽沒有終點。

lines.en: So that'll be in the next video.
lines.zh: 所以那會放在下一支影片。

lines.en: So I'm not going to get into that in this video.
lines.zh: 這支影片我就先不談。

lines.en: However, there is a few more things I want to talk about when it comes to this identity shift and where I've seen a lot of friction and or confusion happening.
lines.zh: 不過，關於這個身分轉變，還有幾件事我想談，就是我看到很多摩擦或困惑發生的地方。

lines.en: It's usually when you don't know what you want in terms of what kind of mother you want to be.
lines.zh: 通常是在你不知道自己想當什麼樣的媽媽的時候。

lines.en: Whether it's leaning too much on social media and seeing what's being fed to,
lines.zh: 不管是太依賴社群媒體、只看被餵給你的東西，

lines.en: whether it is looking at what other people are doing externally instead of asking yourself what feels intuitively right to you. can also be something like you think you want to be a mom but you actually want to focus on your career or you think you want to focus on your career but you really just want to be a mom.
lines.zh: 還是只看別人在外面怎麼做，而不是問自己憑直覺覺得什麼才對。也可能是你以為自己想當媽媽，其實是想專注在事業；或是你以為想專注事業，其實只是想當媽媽。

lines.en: That confusion and not honoring ourselves and our hearts or even like having conversations about it with yourself and with your partner that I think is when it really grates on your soul.
lines.zh: 那種困惑，還有沒有尊重自己和自己的心，甚至沒有好好跟自己、跟另一半討論，我覺得那才是真正折磨你內心的時候。

lines.en: And my son is knocking on the door. Hi my love.
lines.zh: 我兒子在敲門了。嗨，寶貝。

lines.en: I mean if you want to come in you can. Hi buddy.
lines.zh: 我是說，如果你想進來，可以進來。嗨，小傢伙。

lines.en: Free range kid. >> Hi.
lines.zh: 放養的小孩。>> 嗨。

lines.en: P >> you smell like Chinese food, my love.
lines.zh: 你身上有中式料理的味道耶，寶貝。

lines.en: So what I was saying is there is no right or wrong answer. even if you're preparing for motherhood. >> Now, oh yes, >> he's saying light in Chinese because of the the shining on the mic.
lines.zh: 我剛剛是說，沒有標準答案，就算你在為當媽媽做準備也一樣。>> 喔，對，他在用中文說「燈」，因為麥克風上有反光。

lines.en: What I was trying to say is there is no right or wrong answer.
lines.zh: 我想說的是，沒有標準答案。

lines.en: You can only do what is best for you and what is truest to you.
lines.zh: 你只能做對你最好、最忠於你自己的事。

lines.en: And that is for no one other than yourself to decide. This transition is tough. It is hard. It's so confusing.
lines.zh: 這只有你自己能決定，別人都不行。這個轉變很艱難、很辛苦，而且非常令人困惑。

lines.en: There's already so many questions you have in your mind.
lines.zh: 你心裡已經有很多疑問了。

lines.en: Obviously, it's always helpful to talk to people about it.
lines.zh: 當然，找人聊聊總是有幫助的。

lines.en: It's helpful to watch videos on it.
lines.zh: 看相關的影片也有幫助。

lines.en: It's helpful to read books, listen to podcasts, but at the end of the day, we need to decide what being a mother means to us.
lines.zh: 讀書、聽 podcast 也有幫助，但說到底，我們得自己決定當媽媽對我們的意義是什麼。

lines.en: We need to decide why we want to have kids, if we want to have kids, be very honest.
lines.zh: 我們得決定為什麼想要小孩、是否想要小孩，而且要非常誠實。

lines.en: And I feel like this is a good segue to talk about how did I know I was ready?
lines.zh: 我覺得這正好可以接到下一個話題：我是怎麼知道自己準備好了？

lines.en: I don't think like a thing happened or I I arrived somewhere or nothing really happened for me to feel like I was ready,
lines.zh: 我不覺得是發生了什麼事、或是我到達了某個地方，並沒有什麼事讓我覺得自己準備好了，

lines.en: but I feel like circumstantially my life just arrived at a place where I felt like the stars align and it was just the right time for it to happen.
lines.zh: 而是我覺得，就客觀情況來說，我的人生剛好走到一個天時地利的位置，時機剛剛好。

lines.en: Met someone, decided to spend the rest of our lives together, both moved back to where we grew up and the New York City chapter of my life closed.
lines.zh: 遇到了一個人，決定共度餘生，兩個人都搬回我們長大的地方，我人生中的紐約篇章也結束了。

lines.en: A new chapter is beginning that is more family oriented.
lines.zh: 一個更以家庭為重的新篇章開始了。

lines.en: The life is slower, the air is cleaner, the trees are more green, the life is happier. I'm just kidding.
lines.zh: 生活步調更慢、空氣更乾淨、樹更綠、生活更快樂。開玩笑的。

lines.en: Life was very happy in New York.
lines.zh: 在紐約的生活也非常快樂。

lines.en: But it was just like very high pace, hyper like it was a lot happening.
lines.zh: 只是步調非常快、非常緊繃，很多事同時在發生。

lines.en: So because of the change of pace, because of closing of chapters, because everything aligned,
lines.zh: 所以因為步調改變、因為舊篇章結束、因為一切都剛好到位，

lines.en: I just felt like it was the right place and the right time, especially because I've always been someone who knew that I wanted to have a family.
lines.zh: 我就覺得地點和時機都對了，尤其我一直都知道自己想要有個家庭。

lines.en: Now, having lived it, do I think it was the right time?
lines.zh: 那麼現在親身經歷過了，我覺得那是對的時機嗎？

lines.en: In the grand scheme of things, yes.
lines.zh: 從大方向來看，是的。

lines.en: If I could honestly have it my way, I would have wished it happened a little earlier when I was a little younger, so I had more energy, but not too young because then I just wouldn't be mentally mature or ready.
lines.zh: 老實說，如果能照我的意思，我會希望早一點、年輕一點的時候發生，這樣我會更有精力，但也不能太年輕，不然心智上就不夠成熟、還沒準備好。

lines.en: I think it was the right time.
lines.zh: 我覺得那是對的時機。

lines.en: I also don't feel like we should ever use readiness as a gauge because readiness is not certainty.
lines.zh: 我也覺得我們不應該拿「準備好了沒」當衡量標準，因為準備好不等於有把握。

lines.en: Just because you're ready or not doesn't make doesn't really mean anything.
lines.zh: 你準備好了或沒準備好，其實並不代表什麼。

lines.en: I think that's something that I've also known, you know, throwing myself online, trying this new thing.
lines.zh: 我想這也是我早就知道的，像是把自己放到網路上、嘗試這件新的事。

lines.en: Was I ready for it? I don't think so.
lines.zh: 我準備好了嗎？我不覺得。

lines.en: But I just wanted to give it a try because who knows? Who knows?
lines.zh: 但我就是想試試看，因為誰知道呢？誰知道？

lines.en: Something very beautiful could be on the other side.
lines.zh: 另一頭可能有非常美好的東西在等著。

lines.en: So this was something that I did talk to my partner about throughout our dating, throughout our engagement, throughout our marriage marriage marriage is constant check-ins of are we on the same page?
lines.zh: 所以這件事我在交往、訂婚、結婚的過程中一直都有跟另一半討論，婚姻就是不斷確認：我們的想法一致嗎？

lines.en: Is this what we want?
lines.zh: 這是我們想要的嗎？

lines.en: Is this what we're looking for?
lines.zh: 這是我們在追求的嗎？

lines.en: Is this the right time for both of us?
lines.zh: 現在對我們兩個來說是對的時機嗎？

lines.en: Are we ready to do this?
lines.zh: 我們準備好要做這件事了嗎？

lines.en: There is the you need to be ready enough.
lines.zh: 重點是你要「夠」準備好。

lines.en: I don't think you'll ever be fully ready.
lines.zh: 我不覺得你會有完全準備好的一天。

lines.en: Your partner who you're going to do this with also needs to be ready enough and two ready enough people can come together and figure it out.
lines.zh: 要和你一起做這件事的另一半也需要夠準備好，兩個夠準備好的人可以一起把事情想辦法搞定。

lines.en: But unless you are ready enough and excited enough and know that you want this for yourself enough, I would say don't do it until you are ready enough.
lines.zh: 但除非你夠準備好、夠期待、夠清楚自己真的想要這件事，否則我會說，在你夠準備好之前先別做。

lines.en: Again, I'm not saying you need to be fully ready.
lines.zh: 再說一次，我不是說你需要完全準備好。

lines.en: You don't need to be 100% sure.
lines.zh: 你不需要百分之百確定。

lines.en: You need to be sure enough that you want to commit the rest of your life to being a parent.
lines.zh: 你需要夠確定，確定自己願意把餘生都投入在當父母這件事上。

lines.en: As soon as the baby came out, I was like, there's no going back.
lines.zh: 寶寶一出生，我就想：回不去了。

lines.en: There's truly no going back. You can't undo. You can't rewind.
lines.zh: 真的回不去了。你無法取消，無法倒帶。

lines.en: Can't put the baby back where they came from.
lines.zh: 不能把寶寶塞回原來的地方。

lines.en: You just you just have to keep going forward literally for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: 你就、你就只能一直往前走，真的是一輩子。

lines.en: Now that I say out loud, it's actually such a beautiful thing.
lines.zh: 現在說出來，其實覺得這是件好美的事。

lines.en: I think before it maybe would used to scare me.
lines.zh: 我想以前這可能會嚇到我。

lines.en: I think I have this thing with commitment.
lines.zh: 我想我對「承諾」這件事有點障礙。

lines.en: Uh like committing to doing something or committing not to doing something because I just feel like it's just I don't know, maybe it's the Sagittarius.
lines.zh: 呃，像是承諾要做某件事，或承諾不做某件事，因為我就覺得……我也不知道，也許是射手座的關係。

lines.en: I don't like being tied down.
lines.zh: 我不喜歡被綁住。

lines.en: Now that I'm saying it out loud, it's very exciting that, you know,
lines.zh: 現在說出來，覺得很令人期待，你知道嗎，

lines.en: you get to continue to grow and change and you will see this little tiny human being grow and change and you will grow and change together along with your partner and maybe more siblings down the line.
lines.zh: 你可以繼續成長、改變，你會看著這個小小的人成長、改變，你也會和另一半，也許還有以後的弟弟妹妹，一起成長、一起改變。

lines.en: And how fun is that? How fun is that? How beautiful. Yeah.
lines.zh: 這多有趣啊？多有趣啊？多美啊。對。

lines.en: So again, as Fiona mentioned, if you're on the fence about it, give yourself time because if you don't and things happen, this is when resentment happens.
lines.zh: 所以再說一次，就像 Fiona 提到的，如果你還在猶豫，給自己一點時間，因為如果沒有想清楚就發生了，那就是怨恨產生的時候。

lines.en: And I feel like resenting children is just it's so sad. They didn't choose this.
lines.zh: 我覺得怨恨孩子真的是、真的很令人難過。這不是他們選的。

lines.en: It will affect them in ways that we know and in ways that we also don't know.
lines.zh: 這會以我們知道和不知道的方式影響他們。

lines.en: So I think to be sure enough is helpful.
lines.zh: 所以我覺得夠確定是有幫助的。

lines.en: And life is just too precious for us to not think it's the most beautiful wonderful thing.
lines.zh: 而且人生太珍貴了，我們沒有理由不把它當成最美好、最奇妙的事。

lines.en: It's too temporary and too short.
lines.zh: 它太短暫、太短了。

lines.en: If you just think of your place in this universe and how we are literally a blimp, like a little snap in this grand eon of history of time that has been happening, passing, existing.
lines.zh: 想想你在宇宙中的位置，我們真的只是一個小光點，就像在時間流逝、存在的漫長歷史中，彈指般的一瞬間。

lines.en: It is so special for us to be alive.
lines.zh: 我們能活著是如此特別。

lines.en: It's so special for us to be able to create life.
lines.zh: 我們能創造生命是如此特別。

lines.en: And it's so special for that life to then in turn be able to create more life.
lines.zh: 而那個生命又能再創造更多生命，更是特別。

lines.en: If we're able to remember this, if we're able to treat life as this precious thing, then I think the world will be a much much better place because of it.
lines.zh: 如果我們能記得這一點，如果我們能把生命當成珍貴的東西來對待，我想世界會因此變得好得多。

lines.en: So yes, it is a huge commitment.
lines.zh: 所以是的，這是一個巨大的承諾。

lines.en: It is life-changing, life shattering, life mending, life everything everything life as you know it goes out the window.
lines.zh: 它會改變人生、粉碎人生、修補人生，人生的一切，你所熟悉的人生都會被拋到腦後。

lines.en: But I'm kind of crazy and I kind of enjoy these big life changes and I feel energetically aligned with a really really crazy city like New York City.
lines.zh: 但我有點瘋，也有點享受這些人生的重大改變，我覺得自己和紐約這種非常、非常瘋狂的城市能量很合。

lines.en: So it's telling of how I like to throw myself into the deep end and see how I survive if I can survive.
lines.zh: 所以這說明了我喜歡把自己丟進深水區，看看自己能不能活下來、怎麼活下來。

lines.en: So yes, that was how I decided to enter motherhood and the videos to come will be more structured, more I don't know, it'll be packaged better.
lines.zh: 所以對，這就是我決定成為媽媽的過程。接下來的影片會更有架構，更……我也不知道，會包裝得更好。

lines.en: I just made a little bow with my hands.
lines.zh: 我剛剛用手比了一個小蝴蝶結。

lines.en: Um, but this is this is what we're getting with the unscripted with the just talking out of my heart.
lines.zh: 嗯，但這、這就是沒有腳本、直接說出真心話的樣子。

lines.en: So I will see you guys in the next video.
lines.zh: 那我們下一支影片見。

lines.en: If you guys have any questions at all, leave it in the comment section because these videos are now going to be unscripted. We can have fun.
lines.zh: 如果你們有任何問題，都留在留言區，因為之後的影片會是沒有腳本的，我們可以玩得開心一點。

lines.en: It's a lot more casual so I can get back to a lot of your questions a lot sooner rather than before.
lines.zh: 這樣輕鬆很多，所以我可以比以前更快回覆你們的很多問題。

lines.en: I feel like you guys would have really good ideas and it take me months and months to finally get to it.
lines.zh: 我覺得你們常有很好的點子，但我要好幾個月才終於做到。

lines.en: If you do have questions on motherhood, I will try to answer it in the videos to come and I'm going to be making it as these videos come out.
lines.zh: 如果你有關於當媽媽的問題，我會試著在之後的影片回答，我會邊發影片邊做。

lines.en: So yes, hopefully I can get to all of your questions.
lines.zh: 所以希望我能回答到你們所有的問題。

lines.en: And with that, I send you clarity.
lines.zh: 最後，我送給你們清晰的思緒。

lines.en: I send you peace, groundedness. Yes.
lines.zh: 送給你們平靜、踏實。對。

lines.en: I feel like clarity is the thing that can help most with trying to figure out this huge thing, this massive, massive undertaking.
lines.zh: 我覺得面對這件重大、非常非常重大的任務時，清晰的思緒是最能幫上忙的。

lines.en: And with that, I'll give you guys a hug, a little pet. We're doing great.
lines.zh: 最後，給你們一個擁抱、摸摸頭。我們都做得很好。

lines.en: We're all trying our best. I love you guys.
lines.zh: 我們都在盡力。我愛你們。

lines.en: It's so good that they'll be back, like I said.
lines.zh: 就像我說的，能回來真好。

lines.en: And I'll see you guys in the next video. Maybe next week.
lines.zh: 我們下一支影片見。也許是下週。

lines.en: Might get back to weekly posting.
lines.zh: 說不定會恢復每週更新。
